name: Scrubby
description: A scrubber for the Teensy Audio Library: it plays a sound file the way a record plays under a hand. AudioPlayScrub plays a raw sound file from the SD card through a playhead that goes after a target: scrubbed, it races to where the sound is wanted and slows as it arrives, its pitch following its speed; played, the sound runs at any speed from five times forwards to five times backwards, round and round the file.
keywords: audio, scrub, scrubber, turntable, varispeed, playback, sampler, sd card, teensy
